name: The Writer
who: A grad student drafting her novel on a laptop in the corner.
line: Fifteen pages today and I'll trade you a chapter of mine.

name: Madame Odile
who: A retired opera singer who brings her old French records.
brings: New records for the record player
line: Ah, Satie on a grey morning. Shall I bring you Debussy next?

name: The Museum Guide
who: Works at The Met and stops in on her lunch break.
brings: Museum trips and Art Card hints
line: Fifty pages and I'll walk you past the Vermeers myself.

name: The Busker
who: A jazz trumpeter who plays the café's Friday open mic.
line: Finish five chapters and there's a table for you at the speakeasy.

name: The Florist
who: Runs the flower shop next door and hears about every party.
brings: Mansion party invitations when you finish a book
line: Finish a book and I'll bring the invitation with the peonies.
